appearance_facts.fact: Y-axis label: 'Demand index' with scale from 0 to 24.0°C, marked at intervals of 5.
X-axis label: 'Year' with tick marks for years 2005 through 2015.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 2005 to 2015.
The data point for 2005 is at 24.0°C, positioned at the top of the chart.
The data point for 2015 is at 10.0°C, positioned near the bottom of the chart.
The data point for 2010 is at 16.3°C, positioned between the 15 and 20 level on the y-axis.
The data point for 2014 is at 12.2°C, positioned between the 10 and 15 level on the y-axis.

public_definitions: Review the district heat demand dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
